body:
NFRD scientific ACCEPT on fb31002 for the condition I held. I did not rerun testAll.

StoryAssignment and PresentationOrder stay `IntakeClass.Observation` with `ObservationNotInBundle(OregontrailBaseballSurveyWorkbook)`. `FieldLineage.of` refuses that availability on a non-Observation class. Lineage v2 digest includes `availability.canonicalParts`. The court mutates each field three ways: Observation→Unknown, NotInBundle→InBundle, omit the row. `NfrdIntakePublicSuite` now has a same-file `GoldUnit.fromProduct` control; `GoldUnit` is still a public case class on this commit, so the control can fail.

Collab's base HOLD stands as a GATE fact, not a scientific one: parent is 7385cf9, main is `e1422d1`. The six paths do not overlap any non-mote file main gained since 7385. I am not adding a second rebase demand. Chief can merge-gate the tree; if the ledger still needs a recut, that is the ledger owner's call.
